name: LENTERA
source:
LENTERA is a VN-RPG with anthro characters. You play as a dragon cast via distortion into a "new world" by forces unknown. You are saved and meet new friends on a small island where your new life begins. Braving a new world with its dangers, will you be able to regain your memories?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250109045558/https://xerigart.itch.io/lentera]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
LENTERA是一款带有人类角色的VN-RPG。你扮演一条龙，通过未知力量的扭曲进入一个“新世界”。你得救了，并在一个小岛上结识了新朋友，你的新生活开始了。勇敢面对充满危险的新世界，你能恢复记忆吗？

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250109045558/https://xerigart.itch.io/lentera]Itch.io[/url]]
